med-pf-01-c1.text: Europeana. Book Censorship and Banned Books: The Index Librorum Prohibitorum. Europeana (European Union cultural heritage platform).
med-pf-01-c1.quote: The first official Roman Index of banned books was published in 1559 under Pope Paul IV.
med-pf-01-c1.claim: the Roman Catholic Church's Index Librorum Prohibitorum, first published in 1559, listed banned titles for the faithful.
